checks: Multiple prizes can be added to a persistent library
Every prize persists its own countdown, reveal hold and message
Selecting another prize restores its saved editor fields
Any card starts its own settings even while another prize is being edited
Pause holds the public prize countdown without changing campaign settings
A paused prize survives refresh without counting down
Resume preserves remaining time and the original start timestamp
The active card can stop and hide its prize immediately
Reveal now shows the selected prize and its own message
Starting another card replaces the active prize with a fresh independent timer
Stopping an inactive card is disabled and cannot stop a different prize
Show now can switch directly to any saved prize without waiting
Invalid partial edits never crash the app or overwrite a valid prize duration
Returning to a prize after invalid edits restores its last valid settings
Closing settings flushes a final valid edit before the autosave delay
Preparing one prize leaves another active prize unchanged
A prepared prize starts with its saved independent settings
Applying a message to the active prize never restarts its timer
Replacing a prize picture preserves its saved timing and message
The library and editor fit a phone without horizontal scrolling
Inactive prizes can be removed without disturbing the active one
Active prize removal is protected until it is stopped
The bundled library restores saved prizes and controls offline
Start/show/stop controls remain functional while offline
Campaign deadline is unchanged by all prize operations
Library review records no runtime exceptions
On-screen controls stay available while editing below the library
Control dashboard can pause the active prize
Control dashboard can resume and reveal the active prize
Sticky prize controls and the editor fit the phone panel
Polish review has no runtime exceptions
environment: Headless Chromium, production web build and bundled HTML over localhost
fixtures: Three synthetic uploaded prize pictures, each configured independently
standalone: Inline HTML loaded over localhost and exercised with network disabled
limitations: Direct file navigation is restricted in managed Chrome.
Physical TV, hardware fullscreen and overnight endurance remain unverified.
